title: Geometric stalks of a presheaf of sets and of its sheafification agree
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], with category of pointed etale neighbourhoods $\mathcal N_{\bar t}$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods]. For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $T_{\Et}$ (a contravariant functor from $T_{\Et}$ to sets) define its stalk $\mathcal F_{\bar t}=\varinjlim_{(U,\bar u)\in\mathcal N_{\bar t}^{\mathrm{op}}}\mathcal F(U)$, a colimit of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with coprojections $s\mapsto[s]_{(U,\bar u)}$, the class of $s\in\mathcal F(U)$ at $(U,\bar u)$ (for a sheaf of sets this is the stalk of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]). Let $\theta:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^\#$ be the sheafification of $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], $\mathcal F^\#$ a sheaf of sets on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Then the map $\theta_{\bar t}:\mathcal F_{\bar t}\to(\mathcal F^\#)_{\bar t}$ induced by $\theta$, $[s]_{(U,\bar u)}\mapsto[\theta_U(s)]_{(U,\bar u)}$, is bijective.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03PT (lemma-stalk-exact) (2): $(\mathcal F^\#)_{\bar s}=\mathcal F_{\bar s}$ for any presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $S_{\Et}$ (the proof there shows injectivity of $\kappa$ and omits surjectivity; the general statement is Sites, Lemma Tag 00Y8 (lemma-point-pushforward-sheaf) via Lemma Tag 04FM (lemma-stalk-gives-point)); the abelian-group form is lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-geometric-stalk

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take Φ = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pointSmallEtale t̄ (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/EtalePoint.lean:64; Ω algebraically closed is separably closed) and A = Type u for T : Scheme.{u} (HasProducts.{u} and HasColimitsOfSize.{u,u} of Type u; HasSheafify (hence HasWeakSheafify) from Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/AffineEtale.lean:112, whose hypotheses — concrete category with limits and colimits, forget preserving limits and filtered colimits and reflecting isomorphisms — hold for Type u). The component at a presheaf P of presheafToSheafCompSheafFiberIso (line 281) is asIso (Φ.presheafFiber.map (toSheafify J P)) (equivalently the instance at lines 272-274), i.e. the node's θ_{t̄}. Φ.presheafFiber.obj P is the colimit of P over (Φ.fiber.Elements)ᵒᵖ (Point/Basic.lean:96), for pointSmallEtale this category of elements is N_{t̄}, and sheafFiber is presheafFiber of the underlying presheaf (Basic.lean:277). This is the sets twin of the leaf lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-geometric-stalk (same declaration, A = AddCommGrpCat there).
